scope: CPU real Stage viewport lifecycle; native EventTarget delivery; instrumented MediaQueryList/ResizeObserver and renderer sizing boundary. No GPU/browser or browser-GC proof.

checks.name: normal DPR delivery fires once, resizes, and repins to the new raw ratio
dispose before any DPR delivery releases its listener and observer
unwatch while renderer remains live prevents stale updates and registration resurrection
explicit repinning replaces the old listener rather than duplicating ownership
a captured obsolete callback cannot steal a replacement registration
retired callback stays inert after an explicit unwatch and rewatch
fifty independent create-watch-retire cycles retain no pending listeners
DPR clamp and canvas ResizeObserver sizing remain native
listener retirement precedes a renderer-disposal failure and remains idempotent
